_comment: Model rev 3 axis config (stage 0, option B, user decision 2026-10-31; docs/evidence/186-stage0-design-b, 187-stage0-rev3-model). ONE source for RunEnv(model_rev=3) (actuator limits, PD gains, armature, four-bar, masses) and checked against realism_robstride_rev3.json by tests/test_rev3_model.py. ratio = external stage, motor rad per joint rad (< 1 = speed-up belt); link_efficiency 0.9 for a belt or linkage, 1 for direct drive. mount = MJCF body that carries module + drive_kg (pelvis modules ride on the hip-roll link). drive_kg = belts / four-bar / yaw bracket, ASSUMED (no design). The ankle pitch follows the knee 1:1 (no motor), the ankle roll is locked (arch8).

hip_yaw.why: estimated turning load 25 N·m at 8 rad/s (evidence 186); belt 0.10 kg + bracket 0.05 kg

hip_roll.why: peak GRF x 0.10 m; with the 1.5 belt the RMS exceeds the rated torque (x1.43)

hip_pitch.why: speed-up belt: the 11.1 m/s design hip speed 20.6 rad/s fits even at -10 % no-load speed

knee_pitch.why: module on the upper femur, four-bar below (N 0.62-2.15 over the knee band)

fourbar.why: RS04 four-bar search under the 11.1 m/s design stride x1.2 (vendor T-N curve) restricted to geometries whose knee band (both transmission angles >= 30 deg) covers the rev 2 band 0.7159-2.2454 rad: band 0.64-2.265, N 0.62-2.15, utilisation 0.75 / RMS 0.91 (evidence 187; the evidence-186 pick a .115 b .143 c .113 beta 62 stops at 2.08 rad)
